## Data Input
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10))
count_fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

file_path <- "flights_cleaned.csv"

keep_cols <- c(
  "Year", "Month", "DayofMonth", "DayOfWeek", "FlightDate", "CRSDepTime",
  "Reporting_Airline", "carrier_name",
  "Origin", "OriginCityName", "OriginState",
  "Dest", "DestCityName", "DestStateName",
  "DepDelay", "TaxiOut", "TaxiIn", "ArrDelay",
  "AirTime", "ActualElapsedTime", "CRSElapsedTime",
  "Cancelled", "Diverted",
  "CarrierDelay", "WeatherDelay", "NASDelay", "SecurityDelay", "LateAircraftDelay", "TotalAddGTime",
  "split", "use_cancel", "use_dep_delay", "use_arr_delay", "use_elapsed"
)

dt <- fread(file_path, select = keep_cols)
```


## Overview: Does Taxi In/Out Time Affect the Delay Time?
```{r}
#| label: dist-prep

active_dt <- dt[Cancelled == 0L & !is.na(TaxiOut) & !is.na(TaxiIn)]

stats_dt <- data.table(
  Phase  = factor(c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In"), levels = c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In")),
  Mean   = c(mean(active_dt$TaxiOut), mean(active_dt$TaxiIn)),
  Median = c(as.numeric(median(active_dt$TaxiOut)), as.numeric(median(active_dt$TaxiIn))),
  P90    = c(as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiOut, 0.90)), as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiIn, 0.90))),
  P95    = c(as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiOut, 0.95)), as.numeric(quantile(active_dt$TaxiIn, 0.95)))
)

plot_dt <- rbind(
  data.table(Phase = "Taxi-Out", Minutes = active_dt[TaxiOut <= quantile(TaxiOut, 0.995), TaxiOut]),
  data.table(Phase = "Taxi-In",  Minutes = active_dt[TaxiIn  <= quantile(TaxiIn,  0.995), TaxiIn])
)[, Phase := factor(Phase, levels = c("Taxi-Out", "Taxi-In"))]
```

```{r}
#| label: general-hist
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| fig-width: 7.0

ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = Minutes)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), binwidth = 2, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "#4a7ebb", color = "white", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = Median, color = "Median (P50)"), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = P90,    color = "P90"),          linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(data = stats_dt, aes(xintercept = P95,    color = "P95"),          linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ Phase, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Quantiles", values = c("Median (P50)" = "#2a9d8f", "P90" = "#e76f51", "P95" = "#d62828")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Taxi-Out and Taxi-In Times (Up to 99.5th Percentile)",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Taxi-Out: Median = %.0f min, Mean = %.1f min, P90 = %.0f min, P95 = %.0f min\nTaxi-In: Median = %.0f min, Mean = %.1f min, P90 = %.0f min, P95 = %.0f min",
      stats_dt$Median[1], stats_dt$Mean[1], stats_dt$P90[1], stats_dt$P95[1],
      stats_dt$Median[2], stats_dt$Mean[2], stats_dt$P90[2], stats_dt$P95[2]
    ),
    x = "Taxi Duration (Minutes)", y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "gray30", lineheight = 1.2))
```


```{r}
#| label: delay-cor-table

active_dt[, `:=`(
  ExcessTaxiOut   = TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)),
  ExcessTaxiIn    = TaxiIn  - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)),
  TotalTaxi       = TaxiOut + TaxiIn
)]
active_dt[, `:=`(
  ExcessTaxiOut   = TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)),
  ExcessTotalTaxi = (TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut))) + (TaxiIn - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)))
), by = .(Origin, Dest)]

active_dt[, ExcessTaxiOut   := TaxiOut - as.numeric(median(TaxiOut)), by = Origin]
active_dt[, ExcessTaxiIn    := TaxiIn  - as.numeric(median(TaxiIn)),  by = Dest]
active_dt[, ExcessTotalTaxi := ExcessTaxiOut + ExcessTaxiIn]

metrics <- list(
  "TaxiOut (Raw)"                     = active_dt$TaxiOut,
  "ExcessTaxiOut (vs Airport Median)" = active_dt$ExcessTaxiOut,
  "TaxiIn (Raw)"                      = active_dt$TaxiIn,
  "ExcessTaxiIn (vs Airport Median)"  = active_dt$ExcessTaxiIn,
  "TotalTaxi (TaxiOut + TaxiIn)"      = active_dt$TotalTaxi,
  "ExcessTotalTaxi"                   = active_dt$ExcessTotalTaxi
)

cor_summary <- data.table(
  Predictor         = names(metrics),
  Cor_with_DepDelay = round(sapply(metrics, cor, y = active_dt$DepDelay, use = "complete.obs"), 3),
  Cor_with_ArrDelay = round(sapply(metrics, cor, y = active_dt$ArrDelay, use = "complete.obs"), 3)
)[, R2_ArrDelay_Pct := round((Cor_with_ArrDelay^2) * 100, 2)]

kable(cor_summary, caption = "Correlation Between Taxi Metrics and Departure/Arrival Delays")
```

Ground taxi durations are virtually independent of gate departure delays (DepDelay, $r = 0.010\text{--}0.042$), yet exhibit a statistically significant positive correlation with final arrival delays (ArrDelay, $r = 0.104\text{--}0.231$). Across operational phases, departure taxi-out (ExcessTaxiOut, $r = 0.200, R^2 = 4.00\%$) accounts for nearly three times the arrival-delay variance of arrival taxi-in (ExcessTaxiIn, $r = 0.116, R^2 = 1.35\%$), identifying pre-departure runway queuing as the primary ground bottleneck. Furthermore, airport-adjusted "excess" metrics consistently outperform raw durations across every phase, with ExcessTotalTaxi alone explaining $5.34\%$ of total arrival delay variance ($r = 0.231$)—demonstrating that congestion exceeding local airport baselines, rather than baseline hub size, directly erodes on-time arrival performance.

```{r}
#| label: delay-cor-plot
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| fig-width: 7.0

cor_plot_dt <- melt(
  cor_summary[, .(
    Predictor,
    `Departure Delay (DepDelay)` = Cor_with_DepDelay,
    `Arrival Delay (ArrDelay)`   = Cor_with_ArrDelay,
    R2_ArrDelay_Pct
  )],
  id.vars = c("Predictor", "R2_ArrDelay_Pct"),
  variable.name = "Delay_Type",
  value.name = "Correlation"
)

pred_order <- cor_summary[order(Cor_with_ArrDelay)]$Predictor
cor_plot_dt[, Predictor := factor(Predictor, levels = pred_order)]

cor_plot_dt[, Bar_Label := fifelse(
  Delay_Type == "Arrival Delay (ArrDelay)",
  sprintf("r = %.3f (R²: %.2f%%)", Correlation, R2_ArrDelay_Pct),
  sprintf("r = %.3f", Correlation)
)]

cor_plot_dt[, Bar_Category := fcase(
  Delay_Type == "Departure Delay (DepDelay)", "Departure Delay (All Metrics)",
  grepl("Excess", Predictor),                 "Arrival Delay (Excess vs. Median)",
  default =                                   "Arrival Delay (Raw Minutes)"
)]

ggplot(cor_plot_dt, aes(x = Predictor, y = Correlation, fill = Bar_Category)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.72), width = 0.64, alpha = 0.92) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Bar_Label),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    hjust = -0.08, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", color = "gray20"
  ) +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(0, max(cor_plot_dt$Correlation) * 1.48)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Arrival Delay (Excess vs. Median)" = "#e76f51",
    "Arrival Delay (Raw Minutes)"       = "#2b5c8f",
    "Departure Delay (All Metrics)"     = "#a8dadc"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation of Raw vs. Airport-Adjusted Taxi Metrics with Flight Delays",
    subtitle = "Airport-adjusted 'Excess' metrics (orange) consistently outperform raw durations in explaining Arrival Delay",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Pearson Correlation Coefficient (r)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```


## Overview: Does Headquarter Matter?
```{r}
#| label: hq-setup

active_dt[, Airport_Group := fcase(
  Origin == "ORD", "ORD (UA HQ)",
  Origin == "DFW", "DFW (AA HQ)",
  Origin == "ATL", "ATL (DL HQ)",
  Origin == "DEN", "DEN (F9 HQ)",
  default = "Other Top-10 Airports"
)]
```


```{r}
#| label: hq-vs-nonhq-quantiles
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| fig-width: 7.2

airport_five <- active_dt[, .(
  Flights = format(.N, big.mark = ","),
  Min     = as.numeric(min(TaxiOut)),
  Q1      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.25)),
  Median  = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.50)),
  Q3      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.75)),
  P95     = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.95)),
  Max     = as.numeric(max(TaxiOut))
), by = Airport_Group][order(-Median, -Q3, -P95)]

kable(airport_five, caption = "Taxi-Out Five-Number Summary & Tail Extremes (Minutes): 4 HQ Airports vs. Other Airports")

airport_five[, `:=`(
  Airport_Group = factor(Airport_Group, levels = rev(Airport_Group)),
  Group_Type    = fifelse(Airport_Group == "Other Top-10 Airports", "Non-HQ Benchmark", "Airline HQ Hub")
)]

ggplot(airport_five, aes(y = Airport_Group, fill = Group_Type, color = Group_Type)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Min, xend = P95, yend = Airport_Group), linewidth = 0.95, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Min), shape = "|", size = 4) +
  geom_point(aes(x = P95), shape = "|", size = 4) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = Q1, xmax = Q3, ymin = as.numeric(Airport_Group) - 0.25, ymax = as.numeric(Airport_Group) + 0.25), alpha = 0.88, color = NA) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Median, xend = Median, y = as.numeric(Airport_Group) - 0.25, yend = as.numeric(Airport_Group) + 0.25), color = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(x = P95, label = sprintf("Min:%d | Med:%d [%d-%d] | P95:%d", Min, Median, Q1, Q3, P95)),
            hjust = -0.06, size = 2.9, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 72), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Airline HQ Hub" = "#e76f51", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Airline HQ Hub" = "#e76f51", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxi-Out Full Distribution Range: Four HQ Airports vs. Other Airports",
    subtitle = "Whisker = Min to P95; Box = IQR (Q1–Q3); White bar = Median (P50)",
    x = "Taxi-Out Duration (Minutes)", y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
```


```{r}
#| label: hq-vs-nonhq-airline-quantiles
#| fig-height: 5.4
#| fig-width: 7.6

by_airline_five <- active_dt[Reporting_Airline %in% c("UA", "AA", "DL", "F9"), .(
  Flights = format(.N, big.mark = ","),
  Min     = as.numeric(min(TaxiOut)),
  Q1      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.25)),
  Median  = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.50)),
  Q3      = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.75)),
  P95     = as.numeric(quantile(TaxiOut, 0.95)),
  Max     = as.numeric(max(TaxiOut))
), by = .(Airline = Reporting_Airline, Airport = Airport_Group)][order(Airline, -Median)]

kable(by_airline_five, caption = "Taxi-Out Five-Number Summary & Tail Extremes (Minutes) by Airline and Airport Group")

panel_order <- c("ORD (UA HQ)", "Other Top-10 Airports", "DFW (AA HQ)", "DEN (F9 HQ)", "ATL (DL HQ)")
by_airline_five[, `:=`(
  Airport = factor(Airport, levels = rev(panel_order)),
  Role = fcase(
    (Airport == "ORD (UA HQ)" & Airline == "UA") |
    (Airport == "DFW (AA HQ)" & Airline == "AA") |
    (Airport == "ATL (DL HQ)" & Airline == "DL") |
    (Airport == "DEN (F9 HQ)" & Airline == "F9"),
    "Home Carrier (HQ)",
    Airport == "Other Top-10 Airports",
    "Non-HQ Benchmark",
    default = "Visiting Carrier"
  )
)]

ggplot(by_airline_five, aes(y = Airport, fill = Role, color = Role)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Min, xend = P95, yend = Airport), linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(aes(x = Min), shape = "|", size = 3.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = P95), shape = "|", size = 3.5) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = Q1, xmax = Q3, ymin = as.numeric(Airport) - 0.26, ymax = as.numeric(Airport) + 0.26), alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = Median, xend = Median, y = as.numeric(Airport) - 0.26, yend = as.numeric(Airport) + 0.26), color = "white", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = P95, label = sprintf("Med:%d [%d-%d] | P95:%d", Median, Q1, Q3, P95)),
            hjust = -0.06, size = 2.55, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 76), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Airline, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Home Carrier (HQ)" = "#e76f51", "Visiting Carrier" = "#5fa8d3", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Home Carrier (HQ)" = "#e76f51", "Visiting Carrier" = "#5fa8d3", "Non-HQ Benchmark" = "#1d3557")) +
  labs(
    title = "Taxi-Out Full Distribution Range (Min, Q1, Median, Q3, P95) by Airline",
    subtitle = "Whisker = Min to P95; Box = IQR (Q1–Q3); White bar = Median; Orange = Own HQ hub",
    x = "Taxi-Out Duration (Minutes)", y = NULL, fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.1, "lines"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))
```
